strategies.description: Controls the fraud evaluation implementation used by the runtime.
strategies.rollbackDescription: Switching or rolling back the artifact restores the implementation selected by the target artifact. No external compensation handler is required for the fraud strategy.

strategies.description: Selects the payment processor implementation used by checkout.
strategies.rollbackDescription: The selected payment implementation can run its compensation handler before an artifact rollback. The target artifact then determines the available implementations.

implementationDescriptions.new: New payment processor implementation with the current fraud strategy dependency.
implementationDescriptions.canary: Canary payment processor used to validate a third implementation before becoming the new default.

strategies.description: Controls the routing implementation used to dispatch orders.
strategies.rollbackDescription: Changing or rolling back the artifact restores the selected routing implementation. This flag has no external compensation handler.

implementationDescriptions.optimized: Optimized routing path for the standard traffic pattern.
implementationDescriptions.async: Asynchronous routing path for non-blocking dispatch.
implementationDescriptions.experiment: Experimental routing path used for controlled validation.
